📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The pull request expands cluster deployment UI networking support by introducing new CNI options (Cisco ACI, Cilium, Calico, None/Custom), replacing a radio-button network type selector with a dropdown component, creating shared alert components for custom manifests and third-party CNI guidance, and converting network type labels to use translation functions. Custom manifest validation now requires manifests when using external platforms or third-party CNIs. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Localization**
`libs/locales/lib/en/translation.json`|Added translation keys for new CNI providers (Cisco ACI, Cilium, Calico), custom CNI messaging, upload/integration instructions, and third-party CNI guidance. Removed keys for unsupported network type selection and classic networking. Rephrased node pool namespace prompts.| |**Network Type Type Definitions**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/types/k8s/agent-cluster-install.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/types/networkType.ts`|Expanded `networkType` union to include `'CiscoACI'`, `'Cilium'`, `'Calico'`, and `'None'`. Converted `NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS` from static record to translation-aware function accepting `TFunction`.| |**Network Type UI Components**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/ClusterDeployment/networking/NetworkTypeDropdown.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/networkingSteps/ThirdPartyCNIBanner.tsx`|Added new `NetworkTypeDropDown` component with Formik integration and dropdown UI. Added new `ThirdPartyCNIBanner` component for third-party CNI warning messaging. Both use translation functions and conditional rendering.| |**Removed Network Type Component**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/networkingSteps/NetworkTypeControlGroup.tsx`|Deleted radio button-based `NetworkTypeControlGroup` component previously used for OVN/SDN selection.| |**Custom Manifests Alert Components**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/customManifests/CustomManifestsAlert.tsx`|Added new shared `CustomManifestsAlert` component that conditionally renders alert messaging based on `usesExternalPlatform` and `usesThirdPartyCNI` props.| |**Network Configuration Updates**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/ClusterDeployment/NetworkConfiguration.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterConfiguration/networkConfiguration/NetworkTypeDropdown.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterConfiguration/review/ReviewNetworkingTable.tsx`|Replaced `NetworkTypeControlGroup` with new `NetworkTypeDropDown` in deployment config. Updated `NetworkTypeDropdown` to use translation-aware labels and shared `ThirdPartyCNIBanner`. Updated `ReviewNetworkingTable` to call `NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS(t)` instead of accessing as static record.| |**Custom Manifests Validation**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/ClusterDeployment/customManifests/ClusterDeploymentCustomManifestsStep.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterConfiguration/manifestsConfiguration/CustomManifestsPage.tsx`|Updated validation to require custom manifests when using external platforms **or** third-party CNIs. Replaced inline alert JSX with shared `CustomManifestsAlert` component in both OCM and CIM contexts.| |**Index/Export Updates**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/customManifests/index.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/networkingSteps/index.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/index.ts`|Added wildcard re-exports of `CustomManifestsAlert` and `ThirdPartyCNIBanner` from subdirectory indices to make new components accessible via parent module.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - **openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3151** — Directly modifies the same networking/CNI code areas (translation keys, AgentClusterInstall types, NetworkTypeDropdown, custom manifest components). - **openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3319** — Modifies the same feature areas (network type labels, custom manifests UI, ThirdPartyCNIBanner, and translation keys). - **openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3465** — Modifies network-type handling and isSDNSelectable logic in NetworkTypeDropdown and related components. ## Suggested labels `lgtm` ## Suggested reviewers - rawagner - batzionb - ElayAharoni ## Poem > 🐰 A network of nets now grows so wide, > With Cisco, Cilium by our side, > Calico joins the CNI dance, > New dropdowns give manifests their chance— > Third-party banners wave with pride! 🌐

libs/ui-lib/lib/common/types/networkType.ts (1)
`19-26`: **Optional: memoize or cache the labels map.** Converting `NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS` from a constant to a factory means every call site (e.g., `NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS(t)` in both `NetworkTypeDropdown` variants and `ReviewNetworkingTable`) allocates a fresh object and re-runs six `t(...)` lookups on each render. Not a correctness issue, but consider caching per-`t` (e.g., with `useMemo` at call sites, or a WeakMap keyed by `t`) if this shows up in render hot paths.
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@libs/ui-lib/lib/common/types/networkType.ts` around lines 19 - 26, NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS is a factory that re-creates the labels map and calls t(...) on every render; to avoid repeated allocations and translations, memoize per TFunction: either wrap calls to NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS(t) in React's useMemo at call sites like NetworkTypeDropdown and ReviewNetworkingTable, or implement a small cache inside NETWORK_TYPE_LABELS (e.g., a WeakMap keyed by the TFunction) that returns the same Record for the same t; update references to use the cached value so repeated renders do not re-run the six t(...) lookups. ```
